# Real Estate Dates

> Elite Dating & Networking for Real Estate Professionals

Real Estate Dates is an exclusive dating and networking application designed specifically for real estate professionals (brokers, agents, investors). It focuses on matching individuals with similar professional lifestyles, dealing with late closings and early showings. 

## Key Features
- Mutual Matching: Users must mutually like each other to unlock full biographies.
- Anti-Catfishing: Strict ID verification protocols to ensure genuine profiles.
- Tiered Access: Free, Pro, and Empire tiers.
- Add-Ons: Text chat, video chat, and online speed dating available as add-ons.
- Premium Stickers: animated gold-medallion stickers (Flowers, Kiss, Hug, Smile, WOW, Heart, Cheers, Teddy, Fire, Sparkles, Golden Key, Dream Home, Deal, Crown) sendable in any match's chat for $1 each — free to receive, packs of 5 for $5, processed by Stripe and verified server-side.
- Exclusive Events: Online Happy Hour Speed Dating (see schedule below) and in-person walk-and-talk property dates.

## Happy Hour — Scheduled Online Speed Dating (Live)
Happy Hour is a real scheduled event, not a permanent room:
- Schedule: Mondays, Wednesdays, Fridays and Sundays — 5:00 PM Miami time (ET), DST-safe year-round.
- Lobby ("the Ballroom"): opens 4:45 PM; attendees join and see the waitlist.
- Event: 5:00–5:30 PM — ten 3-minute video date rotations, auto-paired; the engine never pairs the same two people twice in one night.
- Consent gate: first-time joiners accept the Event Code of Conduct — private, never recorded, respectful conduct.
- Keys: after each date, both people privately "turn a key" to keep talking. The other person never knows unless the key is mutual.
- Results: at 5:30, every mutual-key match is listed on the Tonight's Results screen with chat and unlimited video between just the two of them. No mutual key = no channel, by design.
- Privacy: cameras optional, dates never recorded, report/block always one tap away.

## Target Audience
Real estate agents, luxury brokers, investors, and professionals in the real estate industry looking to date, network, and build an empire together.
